# Data sources, licences, APIs, and tools

**All payment-level rows in this project are synthetic.** They are generated by `closedesk/generator`. There is no real UPI API, no customer data, and no employer data.

## Synthetic data (primary)

| What | Licence | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Generated NPCI-style settlement rows, bank ledger, merchant records, planted breaks, answer key | MIT (this repo) | Invented identifiers. Not NPCI or bank extracts. |

## Public facts used only to size and label the synthetic day

Copied by hand. Not fetched by an API in the pipeline.

| Fact | Source | Used for | Licence / terms |
|---|---|---|---|
| UPI monthly volume, value, banks live (e.g. Sep 2026: 24,068.38 million txns, ₹29,37,396.67 crore, 756 banks) | [NPCI UPI product statistics](https://www.npci.org.in/product/upi/product-statistics) | Scale the fake day so volumes look realistic | NPCI website terms. **Not** an API. Scripted fetch returned HTTP 403 from this environment. |
| — | RBI DBIE (`https://data-api.dbie.rbihub.in`) | **Not used in the pipeline.** Probed 28 Oct 2026: public, no key, 200 OK. Payment tables are aggregate spreadsheet extracts, not UPI transactions. | Reuse with credit to RBI (verify on use). |
| — | MCA Company Master on data.gov.in | **Not used.** API page required login / API key in this environment. | GODL-India if obtained from data.gov.in. |

Update this table if a figure is refreshed. Do not paste transaction-level data here.

## APIs and third-party tools

| Tool | Role | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| Exasol Personal | Database. Matching and audit. | Exasol Personal EULA |
| `exasol` launcher | Install / connect | Bundled with Personal |
| pyexasol | Python driver / bulk load | MIT (PyPI) |
| Streamlit | Investigator UI | Apache-2.0 |
| PyYAML | Config | MIT |
| pytest, ruff, uv | Tests and packaging | MIT / PSF |
| Optional LLM (Anthropic / OpenAI / Gemini / Ollama) | Plain-language explanations only | Vendor ToS. **Not required.** `LLM_PROVIDER=none` uses templates. |
| Exasol MCP server | Optional later | Not wired yet |

No payment-gateway live API is used.
